description: Use this when the user wants to know roughly what it costs to ship a car, 4x4, van, motorhome, camper or overland vehicle internationally by RORO. Returns IVSS guide prices (typical RORO sea freight from IVSS quotes in the last 90 days) for matching routes, with the route page, and container prices per container (20ft, 40ft high cube, shared) where IVSS has a container tariff for the lane. Guide prices are not a quote: for an exact price use request_exact_quote.

from.description: Country or region the vehicle ships from, e.g. "UK", "Europe", "USA"

to.description: Country or region the vehicle ships to, e.g. "Australia", "Canada"

vehicle.description: Optional: car, 4x4, van, motorhome, camper, truck

name: get_indicative_price
title: IVSS guide price for shipping a vehicle
